overall_comment: Round 2 retrofits all landed cleanly. Empty-lane trap is grounded in Bers 2019 + Grover & Pea 2013 (cited explicitly in expanded_walkthrough.rationale), and recovery_moves branch by diagnostic (A: lane-1-only, B: skipped rows, C: outcome mismatch) with concrete teacher actions a sub could follow. Buzz's refrain 'every LANE, every STEP, gets an ACTION!' opens minds_on and closes consolidation 3x — quotable, transferable. NO-MATERIALS floor-tape path is explicit in differentiation.for_movement_learners, making the lesson runnable on prep-less days. STRATEGY COMPARE step (action.step 6) cites Grover & Pea (2013) on CT abstraction and lets pairs compare different concurrent codes producing the same outcome — clean Level 4 mathematical authenticity. Worksheet Part 3 transfer probe ('both robots must END on the same square') varies practice format from lesson and verifies coordination — justified transfer task. Alignment cross-references yesterday's read-concurrent and forward-references Lessons 3-5. Pair clears the strict bar (no <3, zero 3s).
